name: Nugent Orchards
description: Nugent Orchards grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 801 Crawford Road, MI. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
